analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lille are 35th with 1 point after a 0-0 at Bodo/Glimt and need a win to keep any hope alive. Bayern (13th, 8 points) won 2-0 at Atletico Madrid and 2-1 at home to Mainz, with Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane setting up both goals, but Manuel Neuer is out with a partial foot ligament tear and Vincent Kompany is still recovering from his collapse, with assistant Aaron Danks in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. Bayern's recent scores have been controlled rather than wild (2-0 at Atletico, 2-1 against Mainz, 2-2 against Dortmund), and Lille could not score at Bodo. Neuer's absence could give Lille a better chance than usual of scoring, so the factors cancel and I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners and I lean slightly higher. Bayern should dominate the ball even away from home, and Lille have struggled to create, so most corners should go to Bayern. Lille may also push forward late if they need goals.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. Bayern picked up two yellow cards in Madrid, and Lille had one player booked at Bodo. I found nothing to move the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.9 shots and I lean slightly higher. Bayern create a lot through Kane, teenager Lennart Karl and Konrad Laimer's runs, and Lille's need for a win should make the game more open than their 0-0 at Bodo.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Bayern will create good chances, but Lille's own attack has been poor. I see no reason to move the figure.
